findings.title: Commit markers are checklist items, not plain lines
findings.description: The review criteria require `**Commit**:` markers to be plain lines, never checkboxes. All five commit markers (Tasks 2C at line 71, 3C at line 94, 4C at line 117, 5C at line 126, 6C at line 134) are written as `- [ ] **Task N C: Commit** — ...`, i.e. checklist items that a task-checker could tick as an ordinary subtask, plus they use the `**Task 2C: Commit** —` form rather than the `**Commit**:` marker form. Placement itself is correct (after each implementation+test pair, conditional on file-changing tasks 5 and 6, not after every task and not only at the end); only the plain-line format is missing. Note AGENTS.md mandates checklist format for task files, so if that convention is intended to override, this resolves to a NOTE — but as the criteria are written, these should be uncheckboxed plain lines.

findings.title: Exact `docType` failure message string is not pinned in any task
findings.description: The design's API Contracts fix the human-readable string `frontmatter must declare 'docType: slice-design' (see file-naming-conventions.md)` (slice design, API Contracts block). Task 3 only defines `reason: 'doctype'`, and Task 4 says "the frontmatter message for `reason: 'doctype'`" while pointing at "the design's API Contracts" collectively; Task 4T asserts "frontmatter message" without an exact-string check. A junior implementer following only the task file could paraphrase the wording. Suggest Task 4 name the literal string (or say "verbatim from the design's API Contracts example") and Task 4T assert it exactly.

findings.title: All success criteria traced to tasks
findings.description: Cross-check of the slice design's Success Criteria: PASS/exit-0 on real designs → Task 4T; FAIL with per-heading `missing:` lines/exit 1 → Task 4T; missing-docType frontmatter message → Tasks 4/4T; multi-file order and continued checking → Task 4T; all exit-2 cases with empty stdout including the valid-file-before-missing case and the `cf guides update` message → Tasks 4/4T; `--json` contract → Tasks 4/4T; worktree template resolution → Task 4T (worktree fixture); normalization/matching unit tests (case, whitespace, comments, parentheticals, prefix, level mismatch, fenced block, CRLF) → Task 2T; real-template file test asserting non-empty list incl. `## Overview` and `### Verification Walkthrough` → Task 3T; real-design command test including this document → Task 4T; build/lint/full suite and ~300-line limits → Task 6; Verification Walkthrough steps 1–6 → Task 5. The Integration Requirement (guide repointing) is explicitly deferred to post-release and documented in the Context Summary — correctly not a task. No scope-creep tasks found; every task traces to a criterion.

findings.title: Sequencing, test-with pattern, and proportionality
findings.description: Dependency order is linear (branch → constant → pure validator + tests + commit → file layer + tests + commit → subcommand + tests + commit → walkthrough/parity → docs/full validation) with no circular or out-of-order dependencies: each `*T` test task sits immediately after its implementation task, and each commit marker sits after a build-and-tested state. Effort totals ~21 across 12 tasks; each task fits in a single file scope under ~300 lines; there is a single task file, which matches the slice size. No load-test NFR is restated by the slice, so no load-test or CI-gating task is required.
